queryDefinitions.Q_identity: SELECT current_database() AS current_database, current_user AS current_user, version() AS server_version_full, current_setting('server_version') AS server_version
queryDefinitions.Q_columns: SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, udt_name, is_nullable, column_default, character_maximum_length, numeric_precision, numeric_scale, datetime_precision, is_identity, is_generated, ordinal_position FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position
queryDefinitions.Q_tables_list: SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY tablename
queryDefinitions.Q_table_sizes: SELECT c.relname AS table_name, c.relkind, c.reltuples::bigint AS approx_rows, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_bytes, pg_relation_size(c.oid) AS heap_bytes, pg_indexes_size(c.oid) AS indexes_bytes FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') ORDER BY c.relname
queryDefinitions.Q_indexes: SELECT n.nspname AS schemaname, t.relname AS tablename, i.relname AS indexname, ix.indisunique, ix.indisprimary, ix.indisexclusion, ix.indisvalid, (ix.indpred IS NOT NULL) AS has_predicate, pg_get_indexdef(ix.indexrelid) AS indexdef FROM pg_index ix JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = ix.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = ix.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' ORDER BY t.relname, i.relname
queryDefinitions.Q_constraints: SELECT conname, contype, conrelid::regclass::text AS table_name, CASE WHEN confrelid IS NOT NULL THEN confrelid::regclass::text ELSE NULL END AS ref_table, pg_get_constraintdef(oid, true) AS definition FROM pg_constraint WHERE connamespace = 'public'::regnamespace ORDER BY table_name, conname
queryDefinitions.Q_notnull: SELECT c.relname AS table_name, a.attname AS column_name, a.attnotnull AS not_null FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY table_name, column_name
queryDefinitions.Q_enums: SELECT n.nspname AS enum_schema, t.typname AS enum_type, e.enumlabel, e.enumsortorder FROM pg_enum e JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace ORDER BY enum_schema, enum_type, e.enumsortorder
queryDefinitions.Q_enum_types: SELECT n.nspname AS enum_schema, t.typname AS enum_type FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace WHERE t.typtype = 'e' AND n.nspname = 'public' ORDER BY enum_type
queryDefinitions.Q_member_name_dupes: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS dupe_groups FROM (SELECT name FROM "member" GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) s
queryDefinitions.Q_member_phone_dupes: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS dupe_groups FROM (SELECT "phoneNumber" FROM "member" GROUP BY "phoneNumber" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) s

queryDefinitions.Q_super_admin_users: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active')::bigint AS active, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE store IS NULL)::bigint AS global_scope, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "deletedAt" IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS soft_deleted FROM "user" WHERE "roleType" = 'super_admin'
queryDefinitions.Q_role_menu_presence:
SELECT "roleType" AS roletype, name,
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE("accessMenu",'[]'::jsonb)) j WHERE j->>'menu'='goods-request') AS goods_request,
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE("accessMenu",'[]'::jsonb)) j WHERE j->>'menu'='my-shift') AS my_shift,
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE("accessMenu",'[]'::jsonb)) j WHERE j->>'menu'='business-trip') AS business_trip,
      ("accessMenu" IS NULL) AS menu_null
    FROM role ORDER BY id
queryDefinitions.Q_user_my_shift:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "accessMenu" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements("accessMenu") j WHERE j->>'menu'='shift') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements("accessMenu") j WHERE j->>'menu'='my-shift'))::bigint AS shift_without_my_shift,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "accessMenu" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements("accessMenu") j WHERE j->>'menu'='my-shift'))::bigint AS with_my_shift FROM "user"
queryDefinitions.Q_member_d05_collisions:
SELECT
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT store, LOWER(TRIM(name)) FROM "member" WHERE "deletedAt" IS NULL AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) s)::bigint AS name_groups,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(email)) FROM "member" WHERE "deletedAt" IS NULL AND email IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) s)::bigint AS email_groups,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "member" WHERE "deletedAt" IS NULL)::bigint AS active_members
